subject: Demo kickoff & procurement path — scheduling and stakeholders
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@dataharvest.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Demo kickoff & procurement path — scheduling and stakeholders

Emma — great to meet today, really appreciated the walkthrough of DataHarvest's ingestion pipeline and the use cases you described. Quick recap and a proposed plan so we can lock next steps: 

Recap (2 min):
- Goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for low-latency extraction and summarization on noisy logs (pilot scope: 2–3 models, staging dataset ~10M tokens).
- Primary technical asks: SSO/SAML, on-prem inference option, SOC2 evidence, and an integration checklist for the platform team.

Proposed next step: 60-minute technical demo + platform deep-dive where we bring in our solutions engineer and your procurement/security partners. Please pick one slot that works for you (times in PST):
- Tue Jan 18 — 10:00–11:00
- Wed Jan 19 — 09:00–10:00 
- Thu Jan 20 — 14:00–15:00

Who to include: ideally your platform lead (SSO/infra), your procurement contact, and our security/solutions folks: Marissa Cole (solutions eng) and Priyom Das (platform integrator).

Attachments (short stubs): SOC2-extract.pdf (summary page), SSO-checklist.xlsx — I attached the two doc stubs in case procurement/security want to pre-scan.

Quick asks / next steps:
- Tell me which slot works and the preferred attendees we should expect.
- If procurement needs a PO template or contract redlines in advance, tell me the email and timeline so we can prioritize.

HubSpot record for the opportunity: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
Shared demo folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-dataharvest-demo

Thanks — I’ll hold the three slots for 48 hours and then confirm based on your reply.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
(Attachment: SOC2-extract.pdf, SSO-checklist.xlsx)

From: Emma Li <emma@dataharvest.com>

Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 09:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo kickoff & procurement path — scheduling and stakeholders

Thanks Karthik — helpful recap. Wed Jan 19 09:00–10:00 PST works best for our team. I’m looping Samir (procurement) and Asha (platform/security) for scheduling and the pre-read.

A couple of notes from our side:
- Procurement will want the SOC2 extract and a sample EULA/contract.
- Platform team would like to see SSO details (SAML + SCIM) and a short note on data residency (we run in us-west for production).

Samir / Asha — can you confirm attendance for 1 hour on Jan 19? If procurement wants docs in a different format, tell us and we’ll push them over.

From: Samir Patel <procurement@dataharvest.com>

Cc: Asha Kumar <asha@dataharvest.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jan 2028 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo kickoff & procurement path — scheduling and stakeholders

Forwarding procurement notes and our PO template.

Hi all — looping in procurement formally. A few items we need before we can move to a contracting timeline (typical window: ~2 weeks after docs):
- Sample contract or EULA (for our legal to review)
- Billing contact and invoicing cadence (monthly vs. annual; prepaid options)
- Any export controls / data residency commitments in writing

I attached a PO-template.docx (stub) — if Redwood has a master services agreement (MSA) we can run it through legal, otherwise we use our standard GPO and send redlines. Also confirm whether SOC2 + encryption-at-rest is available (we saw the SOC2-extract.pdf but would like the control mapping page).

Proposed procurement timeline: receipt of contract by Tue Jan 24 -> internal review -> PO by Fri Feb 4 (approx). If Redwood needs an earlier PO, tell us what you need to expedite.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Procurement Manager | DataHarvest
procurement@dataharvest.com
(Attachment: PO-template.docx)
